notes.title: June 21 update: Design adjustments
notes.content:
·Adjustments made to the Druid's Treant build
·Some treasures have been strengthened
·Werewolf, Witch Doctor, and Hell Hound no longer have the intent to attack your hero

notes.title: June 20 update: Strengthen some cards
notes.content: Strengthened some cards of various professions

notes.title: June 13 update: The number of Build options has been changed to 4
notes.content:
- The selection of Build has been changed from choosing 1 out of 3 to choosing 1 out of 4.
- Some enemy bosses have been weakened.
- Some Priest cards have been strengthened.

notes.title: Update on June 3rd: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug: The hero would still be attacked by the enemy with Focus even after having Concealment

notes.title: Update on June 2nd: Reduce the initial difficulty
notes.content:
· Easy difficulty will also open up "Build"
· The passive adjustment of the enemy "Demon Warlock" is "Strike: All other friendly characters +1 Divine Shield"
